name: claude-memory
description: Three-tier cross-session memory for Claude Code: per-session captures consolidate weekly into durable abstractions, auto-injected at session start. Per-project, opt-in, local-only.
author: Eduardo Souza

name: delivery-workflow
description: Feature delivery suite for GitHub: a TDD dev-workflow (with a coverage Stop-gate hook), epic orchestration across an issue hierarchy, PR review-comment resolution, PR-bound CI autoheal, and branch/main CI autoheal for deployment pipelines. Drives code from issue to green.
author: Eduardo Souza

name: issue-ops
description: Turn inputs into structured GitHub issues: bug-rca enriches a bug issue with code + observability root-cause analysis (diagnosis only); spec-to-issues converts a spec/PRD folder into an Epic→Spec→Task hierarchy.
author: Eduardo Souza

name: context-docs
description: Generate a modular set of context-engineering docs under docs/context/ that AI agents lazy-load on demand. Analyzes config, source, tests, CI/CD, and git history to capture architecture, standards, patterns, and decisions for any software project.
author: Eduardo Souza

name: design-to-ui
description: Turn a design into UI components using atomic design. Source-agnostic (Stitch, Claude Design handoff/HTML, or an image) and framework-agnostic (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid).
author: Eduardo Souza

name: llm-wiki
description: Karpathy's LLM-Wiki pattern: bootstrap scaffolds sources/, inbox/, and wiki/ with a schema CLAUDE.md; ingest turns curated sources into cross-linked wiki pages; process-inbox triages the fleeting-capture backlog into the same wiki; query answers questions from the wiki and files good answers back; lint audits the wiki for structural drift and suggests what to research next.
author: Eduardo Souza

name: memory-wiki
description: Turns claude-memory's weekly rollups and flat Tier-3 concepts into a cross-linked, searchable wiki. ingest distils the un-ingested rollups and inbox captures into typed pages; a SessionStart hook puts the resulting symptom index and component map in front of the model; lint reports broken wikilinks, orphans and schema errors without fixing them. Reads what claude-memory writes and never modifies it.
author: Eduardo Souza
